name: Sahil Langoo
title: Full Stack Engineer & Systems Architect
bio: A man of mystery and power, whose power is exceeded only by his mystery. <I design, code & sometimes dream about making art./>
about: I am a Full Stack Systems Engineer and Co-Founder at @SquadCoders, actively contributing to enterprise systems at @ecspl and open source. Based in Kashmir, India, I specialize in architecting ultra-fast static web architectures (Astro, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, daisyUI 5), distributed edge proxies (Hono, Cloudflare Workers & R2, Meta CAPI, Turnstile, Partytown), local AI workflows (Bun, Gemma SLMs, LM Studio), and production observability pipelines (Sentry, Playwright). I believe in building software that is fast by default, zero-waste, and designed with high aesthetic discipline.

principles.title: KISS & YAGNI
principles.description: Simplicity over premature abstraction. Build what is needed with precision and zero unnecessary dependencies.

principles.title: Performance by Default
principles.description: Static HTML generation first, Partytown worker offloading, zero main-thread block, 0.00 CLS, and instant global TTFB.

principles.title: Tactile UI Craft
principles.description: High-contrast typography, calibrated OKLCH color systems, and responsive micro-interactions (scale on press, smooth scroll).

principles.title: Type Safety & Quality Gates
principles.description: End-to-end type safety, Zod runtime schema validation, and automated build-time link and asset verification.
